content:
alana: Quick sync — planning to land a slim-root rebase + privileged-drop change to runtime images today at 15:00 PT. Need RBAC preflight, KMS ephemeral-key rotation steps verified, and audit-log forwarding smoke tests. Who can cover what? :eyes:
nate: I can take RBAC preflight. Which service accounts will be modified?
alana: service-account names: runtime-exec, runtime-builder, image-signer. The change removes CAP_SYS_ADMIN from runtime-exec and moves signer to a scoped signer-role.
devin: I'll handle KMS handshake & cosign key check. Plan is to rotate ephemeral wrap key in staging, verify cosign verify passes, then mirror to prod keystore.
sec-bot: automated: created runbook https://redwood-internal/runbooks/slimroot-privdrop and checklist ticket #SEC-8421
natalie: I can run the audit-forwarding smoke test against staging Splunk sink. Will confirm ingestion and event id mapping.
ops-oncall: Heads-up: I'll be available for rollback window 15:00–16:00 PT. If anything spikes I'll open an incident channel.
nate: For RBAC preflight I'll run these checks locally:```sh
# confirm SA permissions
kubectl get rolebinding -n runtime runtime-exec-binding -o yaml
kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:runtime:runtime-exec create pods
```
natalie: For audit logs, key fields to check: request.user, request.auth.principalSet, responseStatus, requestURI, and cosign attestations. I'll grep for our canary trace id after deploy.
devin: KMS steps (short): 1) create ephemeral wrapping key 2) envelope-wrap cosign key 3) cosign sign --key <wrapped> 4) cosign verify --key <public> 5) rotate keystore alias -> new-wrapped-key 6) backfill metadata. Quick verify command:```sh
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign verify --key k8s://secret/keystore/prod/signer-key-public.pem ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:canary
```
alana: Nate — double-check runtime-exec removal in least-priv model won't break sysctl settings. We may need a privileged init container for cap adjustments; prefer not to.
nate: Acknowledged. I'll run a canary branch that drops CAP_SYS_ADMIN and runs the existing e2e smoke. If it fails, fallback is to pin previous image and revert RBAC in 10m.
sec-bot: automated: privilege-change checklist remaining: [RBAC review completed:false] [Audit sink verified:false] [KMS rotation dryrun:false]
ops-oncall: Reminder: update post-deploy jenkins pipeline to tag the deployment for traceability: export DEPLOY_TAG=slimroot-privdrop-4202468000
natalie: I'm pushing a staging audit-forwarder check now. Running grep for trace id=sr-4202468000-canary. Will post results.
(1 minute later) natalie: staging ingestion: OK — audit events show request.user=system:serviceaccount:runtime:runtime-exec and attestation present. Timestamp offsets ~2s.
devin: KMS dry-run: wrapped key created in staging, cosign verify OK. No signature drift observed. Command output snippet:```txt
Verification for ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:canary -- OK
Signed by: CN=runtime-signer, expired: false
```
nate: RBAC canary run: e2e smoke failed at container start: error mounting /sys/fs/cgroup — looks like the runtime expects CAP_SYS_ADMIN for cgroup namespace move. Reverting plan: we'll try a minimal init container that performs the move while running privileged, then drop caps for main container.
alana: Good find — don't proceed to prod until we have a working init workaround. Update runbook with fallback steps.
ops-oncall: I'll standby for a quick rollback if the init approach also causes issues. Keep me posted within next 20m.
natalie: Audit-forwarding still green. No duplicated events on re-run.
sec-bot: automated: updated runbook step 4 with init-container fallback — https://redwood-internal/runbooks/slimroot-privdrop#fallbacks
devin: I'll run a second cosign verify after the init-image tweak, just to ensure metadata is unchanged by the init flow.
(10 minutes later) nate: Re-ran canary with init-container; e2e smoke now passes. Init container does the namespace move and exits, main runs unprivileged. Logs show no CAP_SYS_ADMIN required in runtime logs.
alana: Excellent. Next steps: 1) schedule 15:00 PT prod rollout with canary gating 2) ops-oncall to monitor 3) sec to watch audit sink 4) devin to rotate ephemeral key to prod on green 5) rollback plan ready.
ops-oncall: Rolling at 15:00. I'll create #incident if any anomalies > 2x baseline error rate.
natalie: I'll confirm audit events 2 minutes post-canary, will post IDS and sample event JSON (sanitized).
devin: Starting prod KMS rotation now (dry-run passed). Will push wrapped key and meta once complete.```
